legend.json: flag: the tool takes --json and build_argv appends it; add: the tool takes --json but build_argv does not append it (MCP_JSON_EXEMPT), so the bridge passes json=True itself (look; also the doctor and contract handlers); native: the tool prints JSON without the flag (probe); none: no JSON output
legend.brief: the tool supports --json-brief; detail=brief (defaultDetail) maps to json_brief=True
legend.paths: param -> path role, see pathRoles; params not listed are not paths
legend.required: always required (also in the manifest schema)
legend.conditionalRequired: param is required when every rule holds: at least one of whenAny is truthy (when given) and none of whenNone is truthy (when given); enforced by the bridge only
legend.choices: accepted values per param, numeric ones included (the manifest keeps only string enums)
legend.mutuallyExclusive: at most one param of each group may be truthy
legend.oneOfRequired: at least one param of each group must be truthy
legend.constraints: relative_name: a file name or glob with no folder part and no '..'; lang_suffix: the value may end in :LANG (a language tag) after the path, so check the path part; jobs_cap: an integer string or 'auto', lowered to max
legend.writesBesideInput: when param is truthy the tool writes next to the named input param, so that input's folder must be inside a write root
legend.nested: the file holds more paths the bridge must check, relative to that file's own folder: brand_json (vendored _common.decision.BRAND_FILE_KEYS: logo, font_file; read), render_project (_common.decision.PROJECT_PATH_KEYS: output is written, the rest are read; plan documents refused), batch_recipe (output_dir is written; project is read; steps name upstream scripts with {in}/{out}), report_pack (the deliverables the pack table names; read)
legend.removed: params refused by name with the reason given
legend.deadline: per-tool wrapper deadline in seconds (null = the call deadline D)
legend.handler: special handling in lib/bridge.py (render, batch, verify, doctor, contract); null = plain build_argv + run_tool

pathRoles.in_file: one existing file the tool reads
pathRoles.in_files: a list of existing files the tool reads
pathRoles.in_dir: an existing folder the tool reads
pathRoles.in_paths: a list of existing files and/or folders the tool reads
pathRoles.out_file: the main file the tool writes; needs an extension; confined to the write roots
pathRoles.out_side_file: an extra file the tool writes when named; confined to the write roots
pathRoles.out_dir: a folder the tool writes into; confined to the write roots
